module.purpose: Provides server-side login-page routing and props preparation for authenticated users, first-time setup, JWT-based TOTP login, and configured authentication providers.
module.summary: This server-side page handler authenticates the incoming request, validates an optional encrypted TOTP JWT, safely redirects existing sessions, routes an empty database to initial administrator setup, and otherwise supplies CSRF and provider configuration to the login page. It combines session access, JWT verification, redirect sanitization, database inspection, environment configuration, and SSO feature flags.
module.businessContext: Supports the product's authentication entry point and first-user onboarding. Failures can misroute users, expose unsafe redirects, block login, or prevent initial administration setup.
functions: getServerSideProps (~L13-94): Routes login requests and returns redirects or authentication page properties.
verifyJwt (~L18-23): Verifies TOTP JWT claims using the configured encryption secret.

env: Reads process.env.CALENDSO_ENCRYPTION_KEY to construct the JWT verification secret.

units.name: getServerSideProps

detail.name: getServerSideProps
preconditions: The context argument provides req and query values compatible with GetServerSidePropsContext.
CALENDSO_ENCRYPTION_KEY and WEBSITE_URL are available when a TOTP JWT is supplied.
postconditions: An authenticated session always produces a redirect response.
An unauthenticated installation with zero users redirects to /auth/setup.
An unauthenticated installation with existing users returns props containing csrfToken, isGoogleLoginEnabled, isSAMLLoginEnabled, and samlTenantID.
Any returned redirect has permanent set to false.
invariants: A supplied TOTP JWT must pass jwt verification using HS256, WEBSITE_URL as issuer, and WEBSITE_URL/auth/login as audience before its email is accepted.
Unsafe or unusable callback URLs do not become redirect destinations.
The function does not redirect to a callback URL unless getSafeRedirectUrl returns a destination.
edgeCases: When context.query.totp is absent, no JWT verification is performed and totpEmail remains null.
When TOTP JWT verification fails, the function redirects to /auth/error?error=Invalid%20JWT%3A%20Please%20try%20again.
When a verified JWT has no payload, the function redirects to /auth/error?error=JWT%20Invalid%20Payload.
When an authenticated session has a valid safe callbackUrl, it redirects to that destination.
When an authenticated session has no usable callbackUrl, it redirects to /.
When callback URL processing throws, the error is warned and the function falls back to redirecting to /.
When no session exists and the user count is zero, the function redirects to /auth/setup.
When no session exists and users already exist, the function returns login props including a CSRF token.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Invalid TOTP JWT input is converted to an error redirect; callback URL processing errors are warned and fall back to the root redirect.
errorPolicy.returnsOnError: Redirect response to /auth/error?error=Invalid%20JWT%3A%20Please%20try%20again for JWT verification failures, or /auth/error?error=JWT%20Invalid%20Payload when the verified JWT has no payload.

detail.ioFormatSpec: Returns either { redirect: { destination: string, permanent: false } } or { props: { csrfToken: string, isGoogleLoginEnabled: boolean, isSAMLLoginEnabled: boolean, samlTenantID: unknown } }.
detail.summary: Determines the appropriate login-page server-side response from the current session, optional TOTP JWT, callback URL, and user count. It redirects authenticated users or setup-required installations, and otherwise returns login-page props.

detail.name: verifyJwt
preconditions: process.env.CALENDSO_ENCRYPTION_KEY is configured for JWT verification.
postconditions: Returns the result of JWT verification when the token satisfies the configured issuer and audience constraints.
invariants: JWT verification uses a key derived from process.env.CALENDSO_ENCRYPTION_KEY.
edgeCases: An invalid, expired, or otherwise non-conforming JWT causes the underlying JWT verification failure to propagate.
A missing or invalid encryption key causes key construction or JWT verification to fail rather than producing a verified result.
detail.summary: Verifies a JWT using the configured encryption key and requires the website URL as issuer and the login URL as audience.

specLiterals.role: JWT audience value required during verification.
